scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/containers-with-counts.test.cjs tests/item-name-search.test.cjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && scp -r dist migrations knexfile.js package.json package-lock.json admin@192.168.0.112:/home/admin/api-deploy-temp/ && ssh admin@192.168.0.112 "sudo mkdir -p /opt/cat-api/current && sudo rm -rf /opt/cat-api/current/dist /opt/cat-api/current/migrations && sudo rm -f /opt/cat-api/current/knexfile.js /opt/cat-api/current/package.json /opt/cat-api/current/package-lock.json && sudo cp -r /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/dist /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp -r /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/migrations /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/knexfile.js /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/package.json /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/package-lock.json /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo chown -R admin:admin /opt/cat-api/current && cd /opt/cat-api/current && npm ci --omit=dev && set -a && source /opt/cat-api/shared/.env && set +a && npx knex migrate:latest --env production && sudo systemctl restart cat-api"
scripts.deploy-with-seeding: npm run build && scp -r dist migrations seeds knexfile.js package.json package-lock.json admin@192.168.0.112:/home/admin/api-deploy-temp/ && ssh admin@192.168.0.112 "sudo mkdir -p /opt/cat-api/current && sudo rm -rf /opt/cat-api/current/dist /opt/cat-api/current/migrations /opt/cat-api/current/seeds && sudo rm -f /opt/cat-api/current/knexfile.js /opt/cat-api/current/package.json /opt/cat-api/current/package-lock.json && sudo cp -r /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/dist /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp -r /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/migrations /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp -r /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/seeds /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/knexfile.js /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/package.json /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo cp /home/admin/api-deploy-temp/package-lock.json /opt/cat-api/current/ && sudo chown -R admin:admin /opt/cat-api/current && cd /opt/cat-api/current && npm ci --omit=dev && set -a && source /opt/cat-api/shared/.env && set +a && npx knex migrate:latest --env production && npx knex seed:run --env production && sudo systemctl restart cat-api"
